items.name: FITLY LLC
items.summary: Strongest monetization prospect: in-home training offer has clear value, but hero clarity, trust strip, consultation explanation, service-area cues, placeholder social cleanup, and mobile polish can make the page feel much more conversion-ready.

items.name: Evolve Personal Trainer
items.summary: Strong local intent and service breadth, with easy-to-explain trust/SEO cleanup: template residue, placeholder alt text, generic CTA copy, testimonial framing, meta description, local service sections, and FAQ.

items.name: Donna’s Home Fitness
items.summary: Warm, credible Naperville fitness page with moderate upside: sharper hero, stronger free-trial CTA hierarchy, trust badges near the top, scannable benefits, “what happens next,” and mobile/Wix cleanup.
